response.original_title: Apollo 10: Green Light for a Lunar Landing
response.overview: NASA documentary on Apollo 10, the May 1969 dress rehearsal for the first Moon landing. Thomas Stafford, John Young and Eugene Cernan flew the Lunar Module to within ten miles of the lunar surface, clearing the way for Apollo 11. Directed by Charles Gallagher, narrated by John Flynn, with a score by Wendy Carlos.
response.title: Apollo 10: Green Light for a Lunar Landing
